reason: I'd take the free first visit on a Saturday to see it, but $15 a kid on weekends adds up fast when storytime and the parks cost nothing. I only get Saturdays, so a monthly plan would never pay off for me.
objection: $15 a Saturday visit, more with a sibling, for something I can get free at the library or park. I can only come once a week at most, so unlimited makes no sense.
would_change_my_mind: A weekend price around $8-10 a child, or a church moms group outing on a weekend where the group rate makes it cheap.
